gist: Sensei had promised Yuuka to keep quiet about a 12,000 yen miscount she made in the club ledger; when Noa asks him directly, he says the error was his own bookkeeping and takes a public scolding, while Yuuka quietly fixes the real numbers.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:30] Sensei, about yesterday's ledger. The 12,000 yen gap was my transposition. Nobody else has seen it and I am correcting it before the council reads it Friday.
[you 07:31] You said you'd keep it between us until then. That still stands?
[user:sensei 07:33] It stands. Nobody hears it from me.
[you 07:34] Thank you. Don't make a face about it.
[user:sensei 07:35] No face. I'm drinking my coffee.
[you 07:36] That's your second today. I'm counting.
[user:sensei 07:37] Third. Counting is accurate.
[you 09:50] Quick logistics. The new printer paper is 1,180 yen a ream, not 1,380. Don't let the shop overcharge you.
[user:sensei 09:52] Noted.
### chat:huddle:r7t2m5c9ya
# {DAY}
[you 12:30] *sets two lunch trays down at the Seminar table*
[noa-ushio] [face=content] Good afternoon. I've been reconciling the October ledgers and I have a question.
[noa-ushio 12:31] There is a 12,000 yen discrepancy in the club account on the 14th. Sensei, I understand you have access to the ledger. Who entered the figure?
[you] *keeps eating, eyes on the tray*
[user:sensei] I did. I entered it by hand from the receipts and I swapped digits. That's my mistake.
[noa-ushio] [face=surprised] You. Not Yuuka?
[user:sensei] Not Yuuka. I didn't check it twice. I'll write the correction note.
[noa-ushio 12:33] I see. Sensei, an adult adviser mishandling club funds is a serious matter. I will have to note it in the council minutes.
[user:sensei] Understood. Put it in the minutes.
[noa-ushio] Please do not make a habit of it. The students rely on this ledger.
[user:sensei] I won't.
[you 12:35] ...Noa, the correction itself will be filed by me. Today. With the right figures.
[noa-ushio] That is acceptable. Eat, Yuuka. You look tired.
[noa-ushio 12:40] *leaves, heading toward Millennium Lecture Building*
[you 12:41] [face=flustered] ...Sensei.
[user:sensei] Eat your lunch.
[you] You've just put your name in the council minutes.
[user:sensei] It's one line. It'll be forgotten by Friday.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 16:00] Correction filed. Figures match, 12,000 restored, signed by me.
[user:sensei 16:02] Good.
[you 16:03] Vice-Principal Kotori's office already called me about the minute. They want you to come explain it on Thursday.
[user:sensei 16:05] I'll go.
[you 16:06] Wear the proper jacket.
[user:sensei 16:07] Yes, ma'am.
[you 20:20] Dinner. You ate? Receipt if you bought it.
[user:sensei 20:22] Ate. 650 yen. I'll bring the receipt tomorrow.
